_vjeyz_: On Day 9, Valentin "Brick" Vjeyz arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Valentin "Brick" Vjeyz watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Hugo "Shadow" Logan and Valentin "Brick" Vjeyz found a cat in the ruins at the Drowned Farm and argued for an hour about its name. The cat settled it by sleeping on Brick. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Valentin "Brick" Vjeyz is number 824. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In R-R8, Valentin "Brick" Vjeyz listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
At the Bone Quarry, Valentin "Brick" Vjeyz of the Concord and Otto Tyner of the Hegemony traded insults across the wire for an hour. By the end they were trading recipes.
In reserve, Valentin "Brick" Vjeyz slept nine hours in a barn. He dreamt of nothing, which was the best part.
A supply man offered Valentin "Brick" Vjeyz a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records.
Valentin "Brick" Vjeyz coaxed the gramophone into turning. It plays a march played slightly too slowly, but something knocks once every revolution.
Valentin "Brick" Vjeyz found an old map of the Sunken Road from before the war. There was a school on it, and an orchard. He looked for them. He did not find them.
aariele_aversa: Dorian "Whistle" Aversa came up on Day 6 carrying news from Halden. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
Dorian "Whistle" Aversa and Quentin Lebronmygoat split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair.
New laces made Dorian "Whistle" Aversa's boots look almost respectable, until he stood up.
Dorian "Whistle" Aversa and Quentin Lebronmygoat carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.
Dorian "Whistle" Aversa passed ration containers down a chain of hands. By the time supper reached the front, every man smelled of it.

Dorian "Whistle" Aversa smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Gustav Thurmansuper came out for a cup and was gravely wounded. On Day 10, Blackwater Canal passed to the Hegemony. Dorian "Whistle" Aversa wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

Dorian "Whistle" Aversa waited for someone in the enemy trench to lift a pair of field glasses. Marek "Tin" Zicharyafour did, and was grazed. The clerk counted the names twice. Dorian "Whistle" Aversa is number 385 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Dorian "Whistle" Aversa did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Dorian "Whistle" Aversa's ear at R-S10 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Valentin Crobus of the Concord (@crobus9).
Dorian "Whistle" Aversa rejoined the squad at R-S10. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
Dorian "Whistle" Aversa counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Florian "Doc" Guyy was badly wounded.
Dorian "Whistle" Aversa started keeping a diary in the back of a field service book. First entry: "Still here."
Dorian "Whistle" Aversa measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together.
alsnafe7490: Norbert Alsnafe was a tailor in Marrow Fen until the posters went up. He came to R-R10 with a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts, and within a day the whole squad knew that he is always the first one awake.

The flare went up just as Norbert Alsnafe reached the Hegemony parapet. Norbert Alsnafe jumped down first. Dorian "Parson" Freddie was the man waiting there, and Dorian "Parson" Freddie fell. (@0__freddie__0) The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Norbert Alsnafe looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

The last of the jam was shared by passing the tin around. Norbert Alsnafe approved the method. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Norbert Alsnafe answered to number 818. Grey Mill is lost. Norbert Alsnafe heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Norbert Alsnafe watched a woman sweep her doorstep. He had forgotten that dirt could be removed permanently from anywhere.
Norbert Alsnafe began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet went into Norbert Alsnafe's chest just under the heart at R-R10. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. The medics had to choose who got the last bed. They did not choose Norbert Alsnafe. He died on the stretcher before morning.
Severin "Brick" Alsnafe had heard about Norbert Alsnafe's courage. At R-R10, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
The line to the battery keeps going dead at the same spot near Calvary Farm. Severin "Brick" Alsnafe suspects it is not the shelling.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Severin "Brick" Alsnafe's ear at R-R10 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Bram Wade of the Hegemony (@wade_b_p).
canaan.a.soccer: They issued Dietrich Soccer a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept his mother's thimble in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.

Dietrich Soccer went over with the night raiders, found the enemy trench empty at that spot, and came back with a bag of their biscuits. Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Dietrich Soccer watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work. Mail came up the line with a letter for Dietrich Soccer. Dietrich Soccer read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Frost on the wire made it sing in the wind. Dietrich Soccer could not stop listening to it. Mail came up the line with a letter for Dietrich Soccer. Dietrich Soccer read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Dietrich Soccer got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 847. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Dietrich Soccer helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Dietrich Soccer won a week of rum at cards from a lance corporal in R-C1. The lance corporal wants a rematch.

A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Dietrich Soccer. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf. Mail came up the line with a letter for Dietrich Soccer. Dietrich Soccer read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Rematch. Dietrich Soccer lost everything he won, plus his mother's thimble. The whole dugout watched.

Third game, by candlelight, with the shelling for a clock. Dietrich Soccer won back his mother's thimble and nothing else. He says that was all he was playing for. Mail came up the line with a letter for Dietrich Soccer. Dietrich Soccer read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Across from R-C1, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Dietrich Soccer saw it. Viktor Spring was gravely wounded. A letter from home reached Dietrich Soccer before dusk. Dietrich Soccer read it twice and slept a little easier.
fatherflowstar: Emil Fatherflowst arrived with the Day 10 draft, carrying a frozen apple and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

Emil Fatherflowst offered a biscuit for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Emil Fatherflowst wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Emil Fatherflowst checked the fire step after the shelling. The wall had moved, and the spot where he always put his foot was gone.
Emil Fatherflowst wrote a letter for Bastian Coiote's mother, because Bastian could not find the words. Bastian signed it.
Wiring party. Emil Fatherflowst held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at T-F18, and everyone came back.
A pocket watch went along the bench so everyone could set the time. Emil Fatherflowst has no watch, but checked it anyway, just to feel included.

Emil Fatherflowst was hit through the chest at T-F18. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Pavel Thesenorfry of the Concord (@thesenorfry). Emil Fatherflowst was killed outright at T-F18, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Pavel Thesenorfry of the Concord (@thesenorfry).
Another member of the House of Fatherflowst reached the line: Otto Fatherflowst. He asked where Emil Fatherflowst had slept, then chose a different corner.
fin83006: Day 9. The corporal put Otto Fin beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
Otto Fin walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Otto Fin was asked to arrange a gathering for men who did not want a sermon. He asked what they did want and wrote down the answers. Otto Fin got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 887. The men who came later will ask about it. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Otto Fin could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
The list for Otto Fin's gathering contains a poem, a song and a request for five minutes without orders. All three seem possible.
Otto Fin reads Wendel "Brick" Andyincorpor's letters from home out loud, because Brick never learned to read. Otto leaves out the sad parts. Brick knows.
Otto Fin buried two men at the edge of Lantern Hill and said the words twice, because the shells interrupted the first time.
Otto Natakhtasha (Concord) shouted a challenge across to Otto Fin (Hegemony) at the Sunken Road. The answer was lost under the guns. Nobody repeated the challenge.
Otto Fin held the gathering in a shelter after supper. The poem was read badly, the song went better, and nobody interrupted the silence.
fuzzysir: Norbert Fuzzysir arrived on Day 12 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle. Norbert Fuzzysir transferred to the sappers. The men in N-F13 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away.

Norbert Fuzzysir spent the afternoon delousing his shirt over a candle. The lice won on points. A letter from home reached Norbert Fuzzysir before dusk. Norbert Fuzzysir read it twice and slept a little easier.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Norbert Fuzzysir tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at N-F13 is up.

A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Norbert Fuzzysir. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer. A letter from home reached Norbert Fuzzysir before dusk. Norbert Fuzzysir read it twice and slept a little easier.
A football came over the parapet from the Concord side with Marek Olie's name scratched on it. Norbert Fuzzysir kicked it back. It did not come again.
haydengonzales: Silas Haydengonzal walked into R-R12 on Day 9 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Silas Haydengonzal helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Silas Haydengonzal had a letter from home. He read it four times and then once more out loud, for the men who never get any. Silas Haydengonzal walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Matthias "Shadow" Slush and Silas Haydengonzal carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle. Now serving as a sniper, Silas Haydengonzal discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.

Silas Haydengonzal and Arno "Hollow" Trout divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion. Mail came up the line with a letter for Silas Haydengonzal. Silas Haydengonzal read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A bullet grazed Silas Haydengonzal's ribs at R-R12. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Ivo "Bones" David of the Concord (@david2449_). Mail came up the line with a letter for Silas Haydengonzal. Silas Haydengonzal read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Silas Haydengonzal is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Silas Haydengonzal. Silas Haydengonzal read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Silas Haydengonzal noticed regular flashes from a crack in an old stone wall. The position looks obvious enough to make him suspicious. The mail bag came up with the soup. There was a letter for Silas Haydengonzal, and the soup went cold while Silas Haydengonzal read it.
isaacburston: Arno Isaacburston came up the line with a photograph gone soft at the edges and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.

Valentin Jarg and Arno Isaacburston argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war. The Hegemony took Hill 304. Arno Isaacburston watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools. The sappers took Arno Isaacburston in on a busy morning in R-F1. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second.

Arno Isaacburston drew the counter-mine plans by candlelight. Below the Ossuary Wood the earth is now a maze, and he knows every turn. Mail came up the line with a letter for Arno Isaacburston. Arno Isaacburston read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Arno Isaacburston saved a seat for someone fetching supper. Holding it against three hungry men turned out to be hard work.
Arno Isaacburston carved his initials into the trench wall next to a hundred others. Some of them are only half finished.
Arno Isaacburston agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age.

Arno Isaacburston was on watch at R-F1 when the night raid hit. The men found Arno Isaacburston at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Marek "Mud" Yummygraingo of the Hegemony (@yummygraingoestomytummy).
Gideon "Mole" Isaacburston joined R-F1 under the shadow of Arno Isaacburston's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.

A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Gideon "Mole" Isaacburston across the shin at R-F1. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Viktor Ghost of the Hegemony (@gaunt_ghost_611). Gideon "Mole" Isaacburston got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 359. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into R-F1. Gideon "Mole" Isaacburston has learned to walk bent double.
The medic looked at Gideon "Mole" Isaacburston's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to R-F1. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
Gideon "Mole" Isaacburston carried Pavel "Bones" Jarg's rifle all the way up to Lantern Hill after Bones twisted an ankle. Neither has said thank you. Neither needs to.
The men have learned that Gideon "Mole" Isaacburston draws portraits of the men in the margins of letters. Tonight it made them laugh, which was worth a great deal.
Gideon "Mole" Isaacburston took stock of his pockets: string, crumbs, a pencil and no sign of the button he was looking for.

The Hegemony raiders were in and out in two minutes. At R-F1 they left Gideon "Mole" Isaacburston behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Bastian Vigneaux of the Hegemony (@le_vigneaux).
Another member of the House of Isaacburston reached the line: Roland Isaacburston. He asked where Gideon "Mole" Isaacburston had slept, then chose a different corner.
krielow.edwin: Jonas "Shadow" Edwin arrived with the evening ration party, carrying his mother's thimble and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.
Officers came to inspect S-S7. Jonas "Shadow" Edwin polished his buttons with mud, which is the only polish there is.
A replacement turned out to be from Saint-Lune too. Jonas "Shadow" Edwin and the newcomer argued about the same bakery for half the night.
Jonas "Shadow" Edwin won a week of rum at cards from a lance corporal in S-S7. The lance corporal wants a rematch.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Jonas "Shadow" Edwin watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Rematch. Jonas "Shadow" Edwin lost everything he won, plus his mother's thimble. The whole dugout watched. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Jonas "Shadow" Edwin answered to number 442. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Jonas "Shadow" Edwin watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Third game, by candlelight, with the shelling for a clock. Jonas "Shadow" Edwin won back his mother's thimble and nothing else. He says that was all he was playing for.
Jonas "Shadow" Edwin agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Jonas "Shadow" Edwin was hit through the chest at S-S7. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Jonas "Shadow" Edwin was carried into the hospital dugout feet first, because that was the only way the stretcher fit through the door. Jonas "Shadow" Edwin is out of danger. Still bedridden, still bandaged, but out of danger.
Jonas "Shadow" Edwin lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk.
Jonas "Shadow" Edwin spent a week on a stretcher in the corridor of the aid post. Today he stood up, held the wall, and walked out to S-S7.
mj_rahimli: On Day 9, Ivo "Ghost" Rahimli arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.

Ivo "Ghost" Rahimli fed a new belt into the gun and laid it on the enemy path at R-C6. Before dawn Jonas Nicopaoletto walked into it, badly wounded. The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Ivo "Ghost" Rahimli looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Ivo "Ghost" Rahimli and Bastian "Bones" Jcadenfarris cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button. The clerk counted the names twice. Ivo "Ghost" Rahimli is number 657 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Ivo "Ghost" Rahimli watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
A splinter of duckboard, kicked up by a shell, went into Ivo "Ghost" Rahimli's calf. The medic pulled it out with pliers. Ivo "Ghost" Rahimli did not make a sound.
Three days with a bandage, and Ivo "Ghost" Rahimli is back at R-C6. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
Ivo "Ghost" Rahimli taught Felix Ryanstebbins to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop.
Ivo "Ghost" Rahimli fired three short bursts at nothing to keep the enemy honest. The enemy fired three back to keep him honest too.

Ivo "Ghost" Rahimli had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Rafael "Saint" Dawgdawghuuu was badly wounded. A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Ivo "Ghost" Rahimli shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Albin Trevor, was grazed.
rastislav_kmec: Silas Kmec unpacked his brother's pocket watch at S-S2. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.
Silas Kmec gave Roland "Ghost" Idiot the last match in the trench. Ghost used it to light a candle so that Silas could finish a letter.

A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Silas Kmec aimed just below it. Albin The was gravely wounded. Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Silas Kmec could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Rumour reached S-S2 that the war would be over by spring. Silas Kmec has heard it before. So has everyone. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Silas Kmec is number 588. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Silas Kmec walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Silas Kmec has fired hundreds of rounds into the dark. Today one of them found someone: Benedikt Rezasiibiil, badly wounded.
Silas Kmec had a letter from home. He read it four times and then once more out loud, for the men who never get any.
A round went through the rim of Silas Kmec's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Marek "Lucky" Rezasiibiil of the Concord (@rezasiibiil).
The medic cut the last bandage off Silas Kmec's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to S-S2 the same hour.
Silas Kmec taught Roland "Ghost" Idiot three words in the language of home. Ghost uses all three at the wrong moment, every day.
ssprinklez_: Day 4: Viktor Ssprinklez reached R-F2 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy. The signallers took Viktor Ssprinklez in on a busy morning in R-F2. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second.

Viktor Ssprinklez tested the telephone and heard someone at headquarters chewing. The line was declared perfectly clear. Mail came up the line with a letter for Viktor Ssprinklez. Viktor Ssprinklez read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet went through Viktor Ssprinklez's sleeve at R-F2 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Mail came up the line with a letter for Viktor Ssprinklez. Viktor Ssprinklez read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Victory at Hill 304. Viktor Ssprinklez let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

A single shot from across the wire hit Viktor Ssprinklez in the thigh at R-F2. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Dietrich Veryprdy of the Concord (@veryprdy). Outside the aid post, Viktor Ssprinklez lies on a stretcher among the others. The orderlies step over him and say soon.
No bed for Viktor Ssprinklez yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up.
The medics called Viktor Ssprinklez 'the corridor man', because he lay there so long. Today the corridor is empty. Viktor Ssprinklez is back on the line.
Viktor Ssprinklez heard a faint second conversation on the telephone line. Headquarters said only one line was connected.

Viktor Ssprinklez went over with the night raiders, found the enemy trench empty at that spot, and came back with a bag of their biscuits. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at R-F2 changed before the cheering ended. Viktor Ssprinklez shouldered another load. Mail came up the line with a letter for Viktor Ssprinklez. Viktor Ssprinklez read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The extra voice came back during Viktor Ssprinklez's test. It was talking about potatoes, which made enemy spies an unlikely explanation. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Viktor Ssprinklez is number 288. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Viktor Ssprinklez watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
The bread had frozen at the edges. Viktor Ssprinklez held it near the stove and defended the space with both elbows.

Viktor Ssprinklez traced the fault to two badly insulated wires touching near a junction. One of them belonged to the supply office. Mail came up the line with a letter for Viktor Ssprinklez. Viktor Ssprinklez read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Viktor Ssprinklez crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at R-F2 holds again. Mail came up the line with a letter for Viktor Ssprinklez. Viktor Ssprinklez read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

With the wires separated, Viktor Ssprinklez's telephone carried only orders again. The section misses hearing what was for supper before it was served. Mail came up the line with a letter for Viktor Ssprinklez. Viktor Ssprinklez read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Viktor Ssprinklez across the shin at R-F2. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Leopold Wihanholtzha of the Concord (@wihanholtzhauzen).
thejewishcuban: They issued Wendel "Button" Thejewishcub a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a bullet that missed him in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
Wendel "Button" Thejewishcub (Concord) threw a loaf of bread into the Hegemony trench at the Bone Quarry. An hour later a sausage came back with a note from Severin Ali: 'Fair trade.'
Rain all night. Wendel "Button" Thejewishcub bailed water out of W-F13 with a helmet until his hands stopped feeling anything.
titlefightlover37: Quentin "Hollow" Titlefightlo was a tailor in Kesselby until the posters went up. He came to R-C8 with a frozen apple, and within a day the whole squad knew that he never sits with his back to the parapet.
Quentin "Hollow" Titlefightlo walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Quentin "Hollow" Titlefightlo kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Quentin "Hollow" Titlefightlo is number 688. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Quentin "Hollow" Titlefightlo shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
The whole squad at R-C8 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Quentin "Hollow" Titlefightlo's bullet that found Pavel "Tin" Satan, badly wounded.

A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Quentin "Hollow" Titlefightlo aimed just below it. Matthias "Ash" Tomtomausthe was grazed. Quentin "Hollow" Titlefightlo reached up to fix a sandbag at R-C8 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Matthias "Ash" Tomtomausthe of the Concord (@tomtomaustheim).
Quentin "Hollow" Titlefightlo came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.
The cook's stew tasted of iron and smoke. Quentin "Hollow" Titlefightlo ate two helpings anyway.
A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Quentin "Hollow" Titlefightlo shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Quentin Zicharyafour, was badly wounded.
topgun_jesus: Cyril "Spark" Jesus walked into R-C10 on Day 9 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Cyril "Spark" Jesus helped stack spare sandbags at R-C10. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Cyril "Spark" Jesus fixed the bayonet, then thought better of it and fired instead. Across the wire, Arno Ali was grazed. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Cyril "Spark" Jesus is number 616. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached R-C10 with the rations. Cyril "Spark" Jesus ate while listening to the revised orders.
Cyril "Spark" Jesus fired at a movement across the wire at R-C10. The man went down: Albin Trevor, grazed.
Cyril "Spark" Jesus started keeping a diary in the back of a field service book. First entry: "Still here."
Cyril "Spark" Jesus tried to remember the price of a loaf in Esterhaus. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought.
Cyril "Spark" Jesus's diary, day nine: "Still here. Soup again. A rat called the Major. Nothing else worth writing, which is the point."
Cyril "Spark" Jesus found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot.
william_white2388: Silas White joined the replacements on Day 8. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
Silas White borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In S-S15, Silas White listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Silas White kept watch so that Benedikt Ahmadifard could sleep. Then Benedikt kept watch so that Silas could. Neither slept. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Silas White answered to number 546. Grey Mill is lost. Silas White heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
A shell landed close to S-S15. When the dust settled Silas White was still there, holding his mother's thimble, laughing without sound.
Silas White wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.
A pump handle snapped off in Silas White's hands. He fixed it while the water rose around his ankles.
Silas White found a flower growing out of a sandbag. He did not tell anyone. He checks on it every morning.
Silas White pressed his ear to the tunnel wall under Blackwater Canal and heard it: tapping. Someone is digging toward him.
